notes: Training mode now explains the signal chips. Each chip (Dist?, Breakout, Inst?, Vol record and the rest) always shipped a full written explanation, but it was parked out of reach: the app strips tooltip attributes so nothing pops up unasked, and the chips were not in the list of things training mode covers. Hovering the most jargon-heavy part of the screen therefore gave nothing at all. It now gives the whole explanation, on hover or on tap.
